payload.ledgerIds: 1..100 unique non-nil UUIDs; canonical authorization target sorts IDs
payload.confirmationToken: required opaque single-use action token; maximum 4096 bytes

authorization.consumption: validated and consumed in the same transaction and savepoint as the financial reversal

idempotency.digest: existing sync push digest over the original wire group, including confirmationToken
idempotency.receipt: existing operation receipt by owner, epoch, and opId

privacy.canonicalChanges: confirmationToken and actionToken are removed before canonical change generation
privacy.conflictLocalCommand: confirmationToken and actionToken are removed before persistence

effects.preflight: validate the complete selected ledger scope and supported dependency graph before writing any reversal
effects.reversal: only supported posted root records and their supported child records; unsupported or linked domains fail closed
effects.financialWrites: group savepoint makes grant consumption and all reversals atomic
effects.acknowledgement: successful clear returns snapshotRequired because the complete dataset may exceed canonical push limits
